source_caption_text:
New York YNs run into Lil Durk’s wife India and show their support for Smurk ❤️‍🩹

Lil Durk, whose real name is Durk Banks, was arrested by federal authorities in late October 2024 and charged in connection with a alleged murder-for-hire plot targeting rival rapper Quando Rondo. Prosecutors alleged that Durk helped organize and fund an attempt on Quando Rondo’s life as retaliation for the 2020 killing of King Von, who was a close friend and Only The Family (OTF) collaborator. The August 2022 shooting at a Los Angeles gas station left Quando Rondo unharmed but resulted in the death of his cousin, Saviay’a “Lul Pab” Robinson.

Durk pleaded not guilty to all counts, including conspiracy, stalking, and murder-for-hire charges. Following a federal trial in Los Angeles, a jury acquitted Durk of all charges related to the murder-for-hire plot. Despite being found not guilty in that trial, he has remained held in custody as he still faces separate federal racketeering charges.
